newsitem.title: USA: Nynex president Jalkut to leave.
newsitem.headline: Nynex president Jalkut to leave.

text.p: Nynex Corp. President and group Executive Officer Richard Jalkut said Monday he would leave the telecommunications company once its merger with Bell Atlantic Corp. was completed.
The merger is expected to be completed by the end of March.

"After 31 wonderful and rewarding years at Nynex, I feel this is the perfect time for me to pursue a second career," Jalkut said. "I'm looking forward to being able to give serious consideration to the many opportunities available in today's dynamic marketplace."
Jalkut, 52, had been expected to become president of the network group in the new merged entity.
Jalkut would have been responsible for telephone company operations throughout the entire Bell Atlantic-Nynex region, which stretches from Maine to Virginia.
No exact date has been set for Jalkut's departure, a Nynex spokeswoman said.
